title: Next to the sea

images.caption: One of our guests sent us this picture! What will you grill while you watch the beautiful sunset from Prossimo il Mare’s balcony?

description: Cozy Prossimo il Mare is located on Corcega Beach. With its breath taking view of Rincon's sunsets, it features a full kitchen and dining table to enjoy your favorite meals. It has a seating area with a comfy couch and a couple of chairs, where you could talk about you day's adventure, or simply watch some TV. The balcony's full-sized table is perfect to enjoy coffee or tea and breakfast, and grill! If you have to put in some hours, Prossimo il Mare has a small desk ideal for a laptop.The spaceProssimo il Mare awaits for you with the sound of calming ocean waves, a gentle breeze to caress your body, and bright rays of sun that will make you happy. But Prossimo il Mare no longer has a pool or a beach. It wasn't always like this. In September 2017, Puerto Rico (and other Caribbean islands) was devastated by Hurricane Maria, the strongest storm to make landfall in Puerto Rico in 85 years with sustained winds of 155 mph. Trees were uprooted, homes were destroyed, and there was also widespread flooding. According to independent researchers from George Washington University, the hurricane caused 2,975 deaths in the six months following the storm. Hurricane Maria also caused catastrophic losses for about 4 miles of Rincón's beach — half of its 8-mile coast, including the beach (and pools) in front of Prossimo il Mare. And while Prossimo il Mare currently does not have a pool or beach access, the dwelling itself still has its charm and coziness. Like the many people from all over the world that helped Puerto Rico during a very dark time, we give back by donating a portion of booking fees to help provide housing for people who had to evacuate their home after a natural disaster, to help provide housing for a medical patient when they travel for an appointment, and to help provide housing for a refugee’s first day in a new country. Please ask if you want to learn more or you are also interested in donating.Other things to notePuerto Rico is currently facing recurring issues with the power grid that have been resulting in power outages. This situation is outside of our control. The property does NOT have a power generator. More information on this problem is available online.

title: The Beach Suite | Hidden Beach Hideaway
description: La Playa Suite is a relaxing suite just steps from Rincon’s secluded beach. Recently refreshed with upgraded bedding, high-speed Wi-Fi and curated décor. This thoughtfully designed suite features a memory foam bed, luxurious linens, kitchenette, coffee bar, and a large private outdoor patio with soaking tub and rainfall shower. Guests enjoy access to the pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, BBQ patio, and complimentary beach chairs, umbrella, and cooler for relaxing beach days.The spaceTucked within one of Rincon’s oldest and quietest beachside neighborhoods, La Piña Boutique Hotel offers a peaceful boutique escape centered around relaxation, authenticity, and coastal living. With only seven suites and a maximum of 16 guests on property, the atmosphere remains calm, intimate, and uncrowded — a refreshing alternative to larger resorts.Located less than 100 feet from one of Rincon’s most secluded hidden beaches, guests can enjoy swimming, snorkeling, sunset walks, and quiet beach days just steps from their suite. A relaxed beachfront bar sits directly on the shoreline, offering sunset views, ocean breezes, live local conversation, and one of the area’s most authentic hidden gems.Despite the peaceful setting, the hotel remains centrally located to everything Rincon has to offer — including beaches, restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife, surf spots, and the historic town plaza. Guests can explore the famous Thursday night Art Walk in the Pueblo featuring local artisans, handmade goods, live music, outdoor dining, and dancing throughout the town square. Sunday mornings also bring Rincon’s beloved local farmers market filled with fresh produce, crafts, and island flavors.Guests also enjoy access to the hotel’s swimming pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ patio, and complimentary beach essentials including chairs, umbrellas, towels, and coolers for effortless beach days.For those seeking adventure or relaxation, nearby rentals and experiences include snorkeling, bicycles, dive lessons, beach massages, and guided local excursions — all conveniently close to the hotel.Guest accessDuring your stay, you will have access to all the amenities at La Piña, including a swimming pool, outdoor patio with loungers and umbrellas, an outdoor kitchen and BBQ, and our favorite feature, the rooftop sunset deck with fire pits. Or grab our complimentary beach chairs, towels, and umbrella, and head to the sand! (Blue and White striped towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in your room) Your room includes a complete kitchenette with a microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker (FRESH local Puerto Rican coffee included), electric hot plate, and all necessary pots, pans, plates, and utensils. The laundry room is free to use, and laundry soap is included. In addition, all rooms come with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.Other things to noteBlue and white towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in the room for showering and bathing. Please use the foot wash by the front entrance or one of the two outdoor public showers to rinse off the sand before getting into the pool. All kitchens have cleaning supplies under the sink and a fire extinguisher. First aid kits are located under the bathroom sink and a large first aid kit is located in the laundry mounted on the wall by the door.
